mapper.select: select dwlr.dates, dubr.pkg, dubr.country, dwlr.version, 0 user_type, count(DISTINCT dubr.user_id) user_num, sum(IFNULL(dubr.balance, 0)) total_balance, sum(IFNULL(dubr.n1, 0)) total_n1, sum(IFNULL(dubr.n2, 0)) total_n2, sum(IFNULL(dubr.points, 0)) total_points, count(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN IFNULL(dubr.balance, 0) BETWEEN 3000 AND 5001 THEN dubr.user_id END)) balance3000_to5000_user_num, count(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN IFNULL(dubr.balance, 0) BETWEEN 1000 AND 3001 THEN dubr.user_id END)) balance1000_to3000_user_num, count(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN IFNULL(dubr.balance, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 1001 THEN dubr.user_id END)) balance0_to1000_user_num, count(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN IFNULL(dubr.balance, 0) > 5000 THEN dubr.user_id END)) balance_greater_than5000_user_num from dwd_user_balance_record dubr INNER JOIN dwd_user_login_record dwlr on (dubr.user_id = dwlr.user_id and dwlr.dates = #{dates}) GROUP BY dubr.pkg, dubr.country, dwlr.version

select dur.dates, dubr.pkg, dubr.country, dur.version, 1 user_type, sum(IFNULL(dubr.balance, 0)) total_balance, sum(IFNULL(dubr.n1, 0)) total_n1, sum(IFNULL(dubr.n2, 0)) total_n2, sum(IFNULL(dubr.points, 0)) total_points, count(DISTINCT dubr.user_id) user_num, count(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN IFNULL(dubr.balance, 0) BETWEEN 3000 AND 5001 THEN dubr.user_id END)) balance3000_to5000_user_num, count(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN IFNULL(dubr.balance, 0) BETWEEN 1000 AND 3001 THEN dubr.user_id END)) balance1000_to3000_user_num, count(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN IFNULL(dubr.balance, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 1001 THEN dubr.user_id END)) balance0_to1000_user_num, count(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN IFNULL(dubr.balance, 0) > 5000 THEN dubr.user_id END)) balance_greater_than5000_user_num from dwd_user_balance_record dubr INNER JOIN dwd_user_register dur on (dubr.user_id = dur.user_id and dur.dates = #{dates}) GROUP BY dubr.pkg, dubr.country, dur.version
